query:
SELECT s.id, s.companyName, s.contactName, s.contactEmail,
       rs.isArchived as rankingsArchived,
       i.isArchived as intakeArchived
FROM sponsors s
LEFT JOIN rankingsSubmissions rs ON s.id = rs.sponsorId
LEFT JOIN intakeSubmissions i ON s.id = i.sponsorId
WHERE s.companyName LIKE '%test%' OR s.companyName LIKE '%Test%'
ORDER BY s.id;
